title: Audio capture is disabled in getDisplayMedia for non-Chromium browsers
test: none added (claim does not hold); checked with a scratch Playwright probe (.arbitra/dev-notes/results/check-14-probe.cjs.txt, output in check-14-probe-output.json) that calls getDisplayMedia from a real click on a routed https page in Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6 and Chromium 153 (control), with HostView's two option sets and with audio requested
proof: The code does what the claim says: for a browser HostView does not detect as Chromium it passes audio: false and no systemAudio (src/HostView.jsx:1342-1343 and 1369-1379 at dev bfe4d26; the same lines at 1281-1282 and 1308-1318 on the audited ac1c688). But nothing is lost by it, so this is not a defect. Firefox 155 returned only a video track for every option set: audio: false, audio: true, audio {channelCount: 2}, and the Chromium set with systemAudio: 'include'. The same profile's getUserMedia({audio: true}) returned an audio track, so an audio source existed, and getDisplayMedia dropped the request whatever the page asked for. Firefox 155 also has no getDisplayMedia audio pref (its xul.dll holds only media.getdisplaymedia.enabled and .previews.enabled). The Chromium control returned audio + video for each set that asks for audio and video alone for audio: false, so the probe does detect display audio when an engine provides it. Safari could not be run here: Playwright's Windows WebKit has no navigator.mediaDevices. For Safari this rests on the documented state, not a run: MDN's compatibility data for getDisplayMedia lists audio capture support for Chromium browsers only, not Safari (cited from knowledge; no network lookup was made). Hosting is not gated either: a non-Chromium host gets only the preflight warning 'Sharing can continue without system audio' (src/lib/hostPreflight.mjs:32-36), never a blocker. HostView produces an audio track only when the capture has one (src/HostView.jsx:1513-1521) and the relay recorder adds a silent track otherwise (791-811). The README marks this path 'Not tested; systemAudio capture is Chromium-only' (README.md:124). The claim's reading of the comment is also off: 'brands the capture option only. It never gates whether hosting is allowed' describes this exact split. The same held on the audited code, so it was not a defect there either.
